$comment: #NEW-23: THE Exponential MCP server entry. Every harness adapter's server block (the Claude plugins' .mcp.json, the OpenClaw manifest) is generated from it (`bun run --filter @exp/plugin-kit generate`); the Rust launcher keeps its own constants and `mcp-entry.test.ts` pins them to these values. `apiKeyEnv` is what a person exports for a headless host; `launcherTokenEnv` is the launcher's own (Exponential's sessions). A request carrying `sessionHeader` is one of Exponential's own sessions: it gets no views (EXP-1212).
